title: Tiny Harbor – Free Cosy Idle Harbor Game in Your Browser
description: Play Tiny Harbor free: drag boats to the cranes, load the cargo, send them out to sea and grow a tiny fishing dock into a busy city port.
body: Boats wait at the anchorage for you. Drag one with your finger or the mouse to a free crane, watch the crane swing the crates on board, then drag the loaded boat out to the open sea. Every boat that sails pays you coins.

Tap the price signs on the quay to spend your coins: more cranes, faster cranes, bigger boats, better cargo, more room at the anchorage, tugboats that bring the boats to the cranes for you and a harbour pilot who sends full boats out to sea on his own. Buy the lighthouse to open the next port: a fishing village, a tropical island and a big city port. Your progress is saved automatically.
It plays with one finger or a mouse, in portrait or landscape, on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and computers. New here? Read how to play and the tips to grow faster.

title: How to Play Tiny Harbor – Boats, Cranes, Upgrades and Ports
description: Tiny Harbor controls and rules: drag a boat to a crane, drag it to the open sea when it is full, and tap the price signs to upgrade your harbour.
body: Docking. Boats arrive at the anchorage at the bottom of the screen. Put your finger (or the mouse) on a boat, drag it up to a free crane, marked with a dashed outline, and let go. The boat slides into place by itself.
Loading. The crane swings crates from the quay into the boat, one by one. When the boat is full, a green tick appears over it.
Sailing. Drag the full boat into the open sea area with the buoys and the big arrows, and let go. The boat sounds its horn, sails away and pays you. The more crates it carries, the more coins.

Upgrading. Three price signs stand on the quay. When you have enough coins, a sign turns green and wiggles: tap it to buy. A crane with a plus adds a new crane, a crane with a lightning bolt makes every crane faster, a boat with a plus means bigger boats, a crate with a star means more valuable cargo, a buoy means more boats waiting, the orange tugboat brings boats to the cranes for you and the captain's cap sends full boats out to sea on its own.

Ports. The last sign of each port is a lighthouse: buy it to sail to the next port. After the third port, the star sign starts you again from the first port with a permanent bonus on every boat. Stars, earned every few boats and at the end of each port, buy new boat colours and flags in the shop on the main menu.

title: Tiny Harbor Tips: Grow Your Harbour Faster
description: Practical tips for Tiny Harbor: what to buy first, how to keep every crane busy, when to get the tugboat and the pilot, and how offline earnings work.
body: Faster cranes first. The first sign costs only a few coins and makes the crane load quicker. A second crane comes next: two boats loading at once doubles your income.
Never leave a crane empty. While one boat loads, drag the next one to another crane, then come back to send the full one out to sea. Keeping every crane busy matters more than anything else.
Bigger boats, fewer trips. Each boat upgrade adds a crate to every new boat, so each trip to the open sea pays more for the same drag.

Tugboat and pilot. The tugboat tows waiting boats to free cranes and the pilot sends full boats away on his own. With both, the harbour runs by itself, and it even keeps earning while you are away: when you come back you collect part of it (up to two hours).

Watching a video is always optional. On portals that offer it, the boat button with ×2 makes every boat pay double for 60 seconds, and the ×2 button doubles your offline earnings or the stars of a finished port. You can finish every port without them.

title: Tiny Harbor FAQ
description: Answers about Tiny Harbor: is it free, does it save, does it keep earning when I close it, does it work on phones and Chromebooks, and what happens after the third port.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser. There is nothing to buy with real money.
Does it save my progress? Yes, automatically every few seconds and after every purchase. On CrazyGames it is saved to your account in the cloud; elsewhere, in your browser.
Does it keep earning when I close it? Once you have a tugboat or the harbour pilot, yes: when you come back you collect part of what your harbour earned, for up to two hours away.

How long is it? The first port takes about a quarter of an hour, the three ports a little under an hour, and then you can start again with a permanent bonus. There is always something new to buy every minute or two.
Does it work on phones, in portrait and on Chromebooks? Yes. It plays with touch or a mouse, in portrait or landscape, and the harbour rearranges itself when you turn the screen.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.

title: Tiny Harbor for Schools and Kids – Safe, Cosy, No Sign-up
description: Tiny Harbor is a calm, text-free harbour game that works on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data.
h1: Tiny Harbor for classrooms and kids
body: Tiny Harbor has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. There is no timer and nothing to lose, so it is calm to play in short or long sessions.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and pictures, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.

It is a gentle introduction to money and planning: every boat pays coins, every upgrade has a price, and players decide whether to save for a tugboat or buy a faster crane now. Prices go up step by step, which gives natural practice with comparing and adding numbers.
It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones, in portrait or landscape, and loads in a couple of seconds (1.6 MB).
